question: How can I register for StudentHub portal?
answer: Click on the Register button in the navigation bar, fill in your university email and basic details, and verify your account.

question: How do I register for technical events or workshops?
answer: Navigate to the Events tab, select the event you wish to attend, and click on Register. You will receive an email confirmation.

question: What should I do if I forget my password?
answer: Click on the Forgot Password link on the login screen. An OTP/reset link will be sent to your registered college email.

question: Are events open to students from other colleges?
answer: Inter-college events such as Spandan and Hackathon are open to students from all approved universities.

question: Can I cancel my event registration?
answer: Yes, you can cancel your event registration from your Student Dashboard up to 24 hours before the event starts.
